description: The Global Risk Platform design language. Single source of truth: the web app imports generated artifacts from this file, and ui.design serves it. Edit here, regenerate — never hand-edit the generated files.

never: a verdict may not be set by the host/client — it resolves from the server
declines, declared gaps, honest zeros and ADJUSTED labels may not be suppressed
no partner/agency logo packs; only a neutral built-with mark carrying a receipt link

caution.meaning: adjusted by a human, model-output, or a declared gap

voice.decline: The system declined to answer — declining beats guessing.
voice.adjusted: ADJUSTED by the requester (not the hub default)
voice.honest_zero: 0 matched — declared as a gap, not hidden
voice.claim_scope: verified = every cited claim traces to the evidence pack; NOT the truth of the underlying sources
voice.retrieved_uncited: retrieved, not cited by any claim
